attributionNote: Turning Point: 1996–2006, Selected Messages of the Universal House of Justice and Supplementary Material, by the Universal House of Justice: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its The Universal House of Justice shelf.
description: The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (The Universal House of Justice).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
